name: Travis AFB
description: Gateway to the Pacific — busiest air mobility hub in the U.S. military. Home of the 60th Air Mobility Wing operating C-5, C-17, and KC-46 aircraft.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.notes: Alternate access for west side facilities.

gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration at Main Gate area.

resources.name: Main Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting mobility wing and tenant units with full meal service.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1900; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0800-0930, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1830

resources.name: Travis Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Travis Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch with 24/7 ATM access.

resources.name: Travis Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, racquetball, and basketball. 24/7 access for registered users.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2200; Sat-Sun 0800-1800; 24/7 for registered CAC holders

resources.name: Travis Inn / AF Lodging
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 60th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Travis Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: David Grant Medical Center
resources.description: Major military medical center providing primary care, specialty services, and TRICARE support.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (707-424-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Travis Inn (707-424-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 60 FSS, M&FRC, and official Travis sites for in-processing and community support.
